entry_points.text: Early boot presets global policy from recognized spellings, warning on missing or unknown values; memory pressure enters through count and scan hooks for deferred splits and the shared zero folio, installed at init and removed symmetrically at teardown.

exports.text: Conditional zero-folio release; reserve and watermark refresh with huge-page headroom; collapse-thread start/stop matching enablement with wakeups; binary flag show/store; tracking-cache init with size-derived budgets and teardown.
Aligned huge-page placement first, generic fallback otherwise; direction flag picks bottom-up or top-down search with tracing; file rmap accounting for the larger huge level when configured.

PUD duplication with retry and write-protect; advice-driven free splits partial coverage, completes with cleared tracking and deferred freeing, and leaves unsuitable inputs unchanged; split-eligibility checks; batched reclaim with migration preservation and restore, ordering clearing before sampling and restoring on races.

Huge moves validate emptiness and alignment, carry soft-dirty and fault markers, refresh rmap, revalidate after relocking, and fail on pins or races, with zero sources normalizing markers; resize splits unaligned edges; protection changes invalidate in place without transient clearing to avoid missed scans, then reinstall, exiting early when already hinted, reducing special entries to readable form; PUD skips NUMA and userfault handling that PMD provides.

hazards.text: Concurrent retention aborts zero reclaim without progress, with safe detachment and diagnostic on missing folio; partial init failures unwind interface, background, and shrinker stages to avoid leaks; constrained systems default to disabled while unchanged policy writes still refresh reserves.

invariants.text: Zero folio is reclaimable only with a sole reference, advertising full huge-page capacity scaled by count and taken exclusively; huge status means shared zero or large remappable compound; fault installs normalize address, enforce frame permissions and folio order; fork shares zero pages, duplicates anon with rmap, delegates special entries, and write-protects sources.

Global policy uses two exclusive bits for unconditional, advisory, or disabled; defrag selects exclusively among direct, staged, combined, advisory, or disabled with no bit meaning disabled; each anon size belongs exclusively to unconditional, inherited, or advisory, with none meaning disabled and inherited deferring to global.

Boot size lists validate wholly with atomic commit, accepting only allowed power-of-two orders; staging uses a single init page; aligned placement requires full-width mode and in-bounds full-quantum coverage; generic placement checks hints with opposite-direction retry; gap search reserves alignment slack and skips conflicts; wraparound yields failure or safe retry.

Single-threaded private means non-shared with exactly one address-space user; NUMA hinting skips already-local cases, top-tier nodes when balancing is off, and device, merged, pinned, dirty file, or shared-COW folios; a fallback variant always declines.

locks.text: Zero-folio pointer updates serialize under a dedicated lock pairing atomic transitions with detachment; anon policy moves serialize under its lock; thread create, terminate, and wake decisions serialize under a mutex so presence matches enablement.

Fault installs hold the table lock; fork and PUD copy nest destination before source and release both; relocation under exclusive ownership nests only distinct locks and flushes the old range when it was present.

Cross-area moves drop the source lock during preparation then reacquire both for final validation; paired locks order by address with conditional nesting; reclaim walks under held locks in batched mode with huge-split and poison-aware walker selection.

state_machines.text: Global, defrag, and anon writes move exclusively among recognized spellings, restarting background work on effective change and rejecting invalid input; startup runs capability check, interface creation, background setup, and shrinker registration, enabling background unless memory is constrained.
Fault installs branch on empty versus occupied entries and folio versus frame carriers, setting access, dirty, and write state from permissions and refreshing translation caches.

structs.text: Policy enums order global, defrag, and anon choices from unconditional to disabled; per-processor tables count events by size with cross-CPU summation and generated read-only attrs; a fault carrier holds either a folio or frame number with a discriminant.

Top-level directory groups global enablement, defrag, zero-page, size, and reclamation controls; per-size objects carry layered control and statistics groups for anon, file, and generic kinds with kind-specific attrs; objects are named by size, tracked globally, and freed by release, with no-op variants in alternate builds.

Global spellings are always, madvise, never; anon adds inherit; defrag uses always, defer, defer+madvise, madvise, never; zero-page and reclamation flags are binary with decimal display; size attribute reports fixed huge-page bytes.
